svg.title: 3C principles map: five shared-context files load by lifecycle phase
svg.desc: Diagram D. Shows which shared-context files (process-rules, code-standards, security-baseline, patterns, quality-gates) load into which lifecycle phases. Progressive disclosure beats a 500-line monolith; frontier models degrade past 150 effective instructions.
